slot_scores.name: min_weekly_production_A
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum/lower bound on Model A production. Turn 10 only asked about a MAXIMUM limit on total units, and turns 11/13 used a vague catch-all about 'additional production limits,' neither of which targets the minimum-A requirement.

slot_scores.name: min_weekly_production_B
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum/lower bound on Model B production. The only production-quantity questions concerned maximum total units and vague 'additional limits,' not a lower bound for B.

slot_scores.name: max_overtime_process_II
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on the total overtime hours that can be used in Process II per week, or can overtime hours be used without any upper bound?
slot_scores.rationale: Explicitly asks for the upper limit/cap on Process II overtime, matching the slot semantics; the cap of 30 hours was then confirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum production requirement for Model A, so x_A and y_A have no lower bound beyond non-negativity.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum production quantity for Model A and the fact was never confirmed, yet the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any lower bound on A.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no minimum production requirement for Model B, so x_B and y_B have no lower bound beyond non-negativity.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum production quantity for Model B and the fact was never confirmed, yet the READY_TO_MODEL model omits any lower bound on B.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while two P1 hidden slots (minimum weekly production of Model A and Model B) remained entirely unasked and unresolved, so the model silently omits required contractual lower bounds.

summary: The agent confirmed several important facts, including the Process II overtime cap (H3), the objective, the exact Process I usage, the regular/overtime split, and the distinct profit rates. However, it never inquired about the minimum weekly production requirements for Model A or Model B (H1, H2), and then silently omitted those lower bounds in its READY_TO_MODEL formulation, stopping prematurely with two P1 slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
